articles.title: 27 Cybersecurity Terms to Prepare You for the Age of AI
articles.description: AI now sits on both sides of the security fight, and the vocabulary has changed with it. IBM’s 2026 Cost of a Data Breach Report found that 1 in 4 malicious breaches were AI-enabled, up 56% year over year. Those breaches cost an average of $6 million, about $1 million above the $4.99 million global […] The post 27 Cybersecurity Terms to Prepare You for the Age of AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .

articles.title: Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite, an Interaction Net CPU Designed by AI
articles.description: Architect Labs introduced Frostbite, an AI-designed CPU that runs interaction nets in hardware. Agents took it from theory to 7 nm GDS, and pre-silicon tests show 4.59x performance per watt over an in-order core. The post Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite, an Interaction Net CPU Designed by AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .

articles.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD
articles.description: Meta has detailed TLX, its Triton Low-Level Extensions that add warp-group, barrier, TMA and cluster control to Python Triton kernels. It runs Meta's ads and LLM workloads on Hopper, Blackwell and AMD MI350 GPUs. The post Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD appeared first on MarkTechPost .

articles.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
articles.description: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval […]

articles.title: Meta Muse can do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart
articles.description: Walmart will let Meta's Muse shop on its website on your behalf, allowing the AI agent to find and purchase Black Friday deals.
